Item: A contract management specialist runs the life of a company's contracts: preparing them from templates, redlining (marking changes on) the other side's drafts, getting approvals and tracking renewals and obligations. They usually sit in a legal operations or contracting team and work in a contract lifecycle management (CLM) tool.
Prepare NDAs, MSAs and statements of work from approved templates
Redline counterparty contracts against the negotiation playbook
Route contracts for approval and signature in the CLM tool
Extract key terms and metadata into the contract repository
Track renewals, expiries and contract obligations
Escalate non-standard clauses to legal counsel
Report contract cycle times and pending requests to stakeholders

Item: A litigation paralegal (legal executive) supports advocates on court cases by keeping case files, filing papers in court registries and online, and tracking hearing dates. They work in a law firm's litigation team or a company's legal department, and do research and first drafts but do not argue in court.

Check daily cause lists and update the hearing diary
Draft first versions of legal notices and replies
Research judgments on SCC Online or Manupatra
Prepare paper books, indexes and affidavits for filing
Update the litigation tracker and MIS for clients or management

Prepare and file monthly and quarterly regulatory returns
Coordinate regulator inspections and close their observations
Run compliance awareness sessions for employees
